description: Trunk UAT run 43229090202 (01a15152ba, 2026-11-12): duckdb write_primitives SF1.0 exited 134 with 'malloc(): unsorted double linked list corrupted' (peak RSS 1.35 GiB) after SF0.01 and SF0.1 passed. Two in-process engines crashing natively on the same benchmark at the same scale suggests a shared cause in the write_primitives harness path (threads sharing a connection, freed buffers, or an Arrow/driver interaction), not two engine bugs.
